NCB busts two heroin routes from Pakistan into Jammu & Kashmir, seizes 6.92 kg

The National Crime Branch (NCB) disclosed two heroin smuggling routes that originate in Pakistan and terminate in Jammu and Kashmir. The operation resulted in the seizure of 6.92 kilograms of heroin. The bust was reported by multiple Indian news outlets, citing officials involved in the investigation. Authorities described the routes as part of a larger cross‑border drug trafficking network. No arrests or further legal actions were detailed in the reports. The reports did not provide a timeline beyond stating the seizure occurred within the reporting month.
